hooks.command:
changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard 2>/dev/null); user_facing=$(printf "%s
" "$changed" | grep -E "\.(py|html|css|js)$" | grep -vE "^(tests/|qa/)"); if [ -n "$user_facing" ] && ! printf "%s
" "$changed" | grep -q "release_notes\.json"; then date=$(TZ=America/Chicago date +%Y-%m-%d); jq -n --arg d "$date" --arg f "$(printf "%s
" "$user_facing" | head -10 | sed "s/^/  /")" '{"systemMessage": ("⚠️  Release notes reminder — update release_notes.json before committing.
Today (Houston): " + $d + "
Changed:
" + $f)}'; elif [ -n "$changed" ]; then jq -n '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  Uncommitted changes detected — commit and push before ending the session."}'; fi
